description: This file defines the EmployeeLanguageAPI class which provides REST API endpoints for managing employee language data, including CRUD operations and search/filter functionalities within a Human Resource Management System.

classes.name: EmployeeLanguageAPI
classes.description: A REST API controller providing endpoints for CRUD operations and managing employee language data, including listing, adding, updating, and deleting employee language records.

methods.name: getOne
methods.description: Fetches a specific employee language record based on employee number, language ID, and fluency ID.

methods.name: getAll
methods.description: Lists all language records associated with a specific employee, including search and pagination features.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Creates a new employee language record with specified language, fluency, competency, and comment.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Updates an existing employee language record with new language, fluency, competency, or comment information.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Deletes one or more specified employee language records based on provided IDs.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForGetOne
methods.description: Provides validation rules for retrieving a single employee language record.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForGetAll
methods.description: Provides validation rules for listing employee languages.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForCreate
methods.description: Provides validation rules for creating a new employee language record.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForUpdate
methods.description: Provides validation rules for updating an existing employee language record.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForDelete
methods.description: Provides validation rules for deleting employee language records.

methods.name: getUrlAttributes
methods.description: Retrieves URL parameters for employee number, language ID, and fluency ID.

methods.name: setEmployeeLanguage
methods.description: Sets the properties of an EmployeeLanguage entity based on request inputs, including competency and comment.

methods.name: getEmpNumberRule
methods.description: Returns validation rule for verifying employee number accessibility.

methods.name: getLanguageIdRule
methods.description: Returns validation rule ensuring language ID is positive.

methods.name: getFluencyIdRule
methods.description: Returns validation rule to ensure fluency ID is within allowed options.

methods.name: getCompetencyIdRule
methods.description: Returns validation rule to verify competency ID is within allowed options.

methods.name: getCommentRule
methods.description: Returns validation rule for comment string length and type.
